title: 2024 Bowman Mojo Refractor #96 Jazz Chisolm Jr. Miami Marlins Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2024 Bowman Chrome Mega Jazz Chisolm Jr Mojo trading card is a must-have for any baseball fan. Featuring the Miami Marlins player in a stunning Mojo Refractor parallel/variety, this card is sure to be a standout in your collection. The card number is 96 and it is from the 2024 season. 

The card is manufactured by Bowman and is part of the Major League (MLB) league. It is a sports trading card that falls under the categories of Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop and Sports Trading Cards. Don't miss out on the opportunity to add this unique and rare card to your collection.
